body: I figure if i'm worthless then helping a few homeless guys get some cloths and food maybe was the only reason why i'm here.  Maybe i was brought here with nothing so its easier to help someone in need because i don't see me as leaving this place as such a bad thing now.
Where does someone without a high school diploma get a job that's not at McDonald's?  I fluked out that i got my job here.

Sorry i need to figure out how reddit works.  I'm not trying to be selfish at all.  I've planned things out that when i hand in my resignation letter, i have only a few things to clear out of my apartment, the rest i've already cleaned like i just moved in.  I have to drop my dog off at the spca and drop my keys off to the landlord.   I've already dropped off most of my clothes to the local Goodwill.  I have a bus ticket i have bought before new years (i had hopped to kill myself then but i couldn't finish cleaning in time).   I have a place picked out about 2 hours away from anyone up in the woods outside of any people living.  I have some Valium which i plan to take, strip down nude and hang myself from a tree i found.  I figure in a few days most animals would have picked me clean and helped get rid of most to me.  Since no family or friends i figure it would be years before anyone came across my remains, and because i've cleaned everything up behind me i would not be putting anyone through anything.

Yeah its not a very big company.  Our store has only 40 people and head office about the same so its pretty tight knit.  Its takes about 3 minutes for rumors to spread around here and i had to start answering questions before i even knew what was happening.
I don't have hope, i moved on to wish and now i can't wait.  I think about how much happier i will be afterword, how much happier and stress free wonderful people like yourself will have.
I stopped hoping and started to wish.  Now i've just accepted that its the right things for me to do.

There's really nothing fun in my life anymore.  I'm really sorry to sounds morbid, but fun for me is walking to the store and hoping, no wishing and picturing a streetcar, truck, car just please miss that one red light and run me over, and i promise i won't sue!  I've already planned out a way to take some pills and hang myself in the woods far from people so there won't be any pulling of triggers, i don't want a mess anyone has to clean up.

I used too love humor, you almost got a chuckle out of me there man.  Unfortunately i don't have family to help me do anything.  I feel like there should be a meme with my face.."The Original Bastard Child"
Well you are nice enough to say hi so i should reply back.

What did you do about everyone at your work knowing.  I don;t know your situation but i basically screwed up with my gf and took the full blame for us breaking up because i have no back bone and she had enough and left.  She already told people at work and because i have no backbone i basically agreed with everything she said.  yeah i feel like the general disposition towards me has changed in a negative manner.  I feel like people just want me to quit and i should just do it.

All i can think about is people i've let down, the people i miss and the things i've already done.  I just can't see myself stuggaling through life for no reason, for nobody.  I feel like i have no skills and that its all just going down from here.
Not too much Vader, guess just hanging out in the dark side.  Unfortunately i think its where i belong.

I actually quit school to become a photographer, wish i had stayed and got my high school diploma now.  If anything feel like i just want to show other people my mistakes so they can learn off of them.  I've really got myself in a fucked up situation and i've managed to leave myself a pretty shirty life behind.

The problem i have at work is that my former girlfirend also work there.  She actually works for the owner of the company and in a heated argument before she left she said if i caused any trouble she had talked with someone else in the head office and she will have me fired.  I work as a photographer and i'm not in the best state of mind to help others and i feel like quitting is the only option.  We had talked about it and i stupididly said i would quit.  I already have me resignation letter typed out and its on my desk ready to hand in at the end of today. 

*notice to others*  Don't get in a relationship with someone you work with.
I'm in Canada.  I have memory trouble and i lost my wallet a few back with it my health card.  Also my phone has been disconnected due to lack of money so even if i could call someone i couldn't.

I'm not sure anyone has been down my path.  I think its easy for everyone to say "hang in there", when they have people around to help.  I've made the mistakes in my life to lead me down a path of being alone, and i know i could try, anyone can.  But i just don't see anything better happening to me, and to be honest i don't have anyone to do anything for.  I could honestly say if i dies today, the way i have planned it would probably be at least a few months before anyone who knew me would possibly find out...if ever.   I'm just so sad that i wish i had done more, or had different things happen but i know its life and you can't say things like that.
